name: security-helm-values-trust-review
intent: Helm values and post-render transformations crossing deployment authority
artifacts: Chart templates/dependencies, values sources, release principal and post-render commands.
trace: Follow lower-trust values into security-sensitive rendered fields or post-render execution. Distinguish intended operator configuration from an untrusted tenant parameter.
experiment: Render an owned inert chart with permitted values and one untrusted security-field change; inspect the final manifest and release policy without installing it.
disproof: A chart supporting privileged options is not a vulnerability when only a trusted cluster operator controls them.
repair: Constrain exposed values and final admission policy, verifying legitimate rendering and blocked privilege changes.
branch_decisions: Rendered manifests are the security-relevant output, including dependencies, tpl evaluation and post-render changes. Values may intentionally grant chart configuration authority but must not silently exceed a caller contract. Render in an isolated non-cluster environment first; template evaluation and any external renderer are executable build inputs, not passive YAML parsing.
